# Fenkell Rx Pharmacy

> Independent pharmacy at 18360 Fenkell Ave, Detroit, MI 48223. Phone: (313) 519-5700. We serve Northwest Detroit, Redford Township, and Southfield with free same-day prescription delivery, prescription transfers, vaccines, GLP-1 medications, diabetic supplies, compounding, and blister packaging. We accept most insurance plans including Medicare and Medicaid.

## Core Services

- [Homepage](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/): Overview of all pharmacy services, quick refill and transfer links
- [Prescription Refills](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/refills): Online refill request form — quick, easy, no phone call needed
- [Prescription Transfers](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/transfer): Free 2-minute prescription transfer from any pharmacy
- [Online Doctor Visit / QuickCare](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/quickcare): Book an online doctor visit for same-day prescriptions
- [Medication Availability](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/availability): Live inventory of hard-to-find medications in Detroit
- [All Medications List](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/medications): Full medication availability directory with status
- [Vaccines Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/vaccines-detroit): Walk-in flu, COVID-19, RSV, shingles (Shingrix) vaccines — no appointment needed
- [Free Prescription Delivery Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/free-prescription-delivery-detroit): Free same-day delivery across Northwest Detroit, Redford Township, Southfield
- [Diabetic Supplies Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/diabetic-supplies-detroit): Glucose meters, test strips, insulin, CGM supplies
- [Compounding Pharmacy Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/compounding-pharmacy-detroit): Custom compounded medications
- [Blister Packaging Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/blister-packaging-detroit): Medication blister packs for seniors and caregivers
- [Insurance Detroit](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/insurance-detroit): Accepted insurance plans including Medicare Part D, Medicaid, Blue Cross
- [Contact / Message Pharmacist](https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/message): Send a message directly to our pharmacy team
